subject: FREEZE L4 d6c8a82 — native build starting
body: Snapshot commit d6c8a82 (all integrated production + tests). Native build now: air (cargo iOS, jobs1) -> mali (Mesa iOS, ninja -j1) -> frontend -> strict link -> addon. Post-build root verifies git diff HEAD -- gpu/metal is empty; any write during the window invalidates the build. Work in private copies until UNFREEZE.
